title: On directional second-order tangent sets of analytic sets and applications in optimization
summary: In this paper we study directional second-order tangent sets of real and complex analytic sets. For an analytic set $X\subseteq \mathbb K^n$ and a nonzero tangent direction $u\in T_0X$, we compare the geometric directional second-order tangent set $T^2_{0,u}X$, defined through second-order expansions of analytic curves in $X$, with the algebraic directional second-order tangent set $T^{2,a}_{0,u}X$, defined by the initial forms of the equations of $X$.
